Name: Wave-Sec Soldier
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward

traits.name: Mounted Expert
traits.description: When the soldier is mounted on a creature or operating a vehicle, their own weapon attacks and saving throws have advantage.

traits.name: Night Vision Visor
traits.description: The soldier is equipped with a mask that allows them to see in darkness within 60 feet as if it was bright light, but colors are all muted to a soft bluish-gray in that range.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The soldier makes two Electric Staff attacks or one Wave Rifle attack.

actions.name: Electric Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d4) lightning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d4) lightning damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Wave Rifle
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60/180, reload 2, one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. If the soldier is prone while making this attack, they can fire up to its long range without disadvantage from either being prone or at a distance.

bonus_actions.name: Wave-Sec Operational Training
bonus_actions.description: When the soldier is operating a Wave-Sec vehicle or is a Station Operator in a vehicle, they can use their bonus action to give one attack roll or ability check the vehicle makes advantage.
